# Siplicity - Free and open source edition

![siplicity-foss logo](siplicity-foss.png)

## About

[Siplicity](https://sipli-city) makes transferring digital files simple.

Siplicity is licensed under the [Fair Core License](https://fcl.dev/). This means that licensed users receive access to Siplicity’s source code and can modify the application and distribute those modifications for use by other licensed users. It also means that Siplicity's code automatically transitions to open source (Apache 2.0) after two years.

This repository is automatically synced to the main Siplicity repository, publishing changes from its main branch at a two year delay.

## License

Code in this repository is older than two years and has automatically transitioned to open source. It is licensed under the [Apache License, version 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

## FAQs

### Why can’t I post an issue, pull request, or discussion? 

Have you ever seen [The Langoliers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Langoliers_(miniseries))? This repository is flying two years behind Siplicity. Making changes to it can have no effect on the future, and will make it harder to automatically merge Siplicity’s change history. Forks are welcome.
